mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employees (client_id, user_id, first_name, last_name, system_role, image_url, salary) VALUES (#{request.clientId}, #{request.userId}, #{request.firstName}, #{request.lastName}, #{request.systemRole}, #{request.imageUrl}, #{request.salary})
mapper.update: UPDATE employees SET first_name = #{request.firstName}, last_name = #{request.lastName}, system_role = #{request.systemRole}, image_url = #{request.imageUrl}, salary = #{request.salary}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE client_id = #{request.clientId} AND delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}

UPDATE employees SET delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@DELETED.value}, deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE client_id = #{clientId} AND delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}

UPDATE employees SET first_name = #{request.firstName}, last_name = #{request.lastName}, system_role = #{request.systemRole}, image_url = #{request.imageUrl}, salary = #{request.salary}, delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}, deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE client_id = #{request.clientId} AND delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@DELETED.value}
mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN department_employees de ON e.client_id = de.employee_id AND de.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} LEFT JOIN departments d ON de.department_code = d.department_code AND d.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} LEFT JOIN roles dr ON de.role_code = dr.role_code AND dr.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}

LEFT JOIN team_employees te ON e.client_id = te.employee_id AND te.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} LEFT JOIN teams t ON te.team_code = t.team_code AND t.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} LEFT JOIN roles tr ON te.role_code = tr.role_code AND tr.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}
